objective: Update exact generic state with one synchronous callback invocation.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Functional state updates are a common application pattern.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Compute a replacement from current state without duplicating effects.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Callback count, opaque identity and linked generic parameter/return types transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the update-only checkpoint before subscriptions.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Calling an updater twice can repeat effects and erase the intended contract.

defects: Examples did not detect repeated updater execution.
Opaque values and detached update ownership were implicit.
An any-erased updater could pass inherited setter/getter probes.
rationale: Retain the correct sole reference and all preceding exact opaque-state assertions. Define synchronous exactly-once update of the original current T, passing its exact result through set without clone/coercion/await; callbacks do not throw, mutate the same store or depend on this. Keep update detached and typed (T)=>T returning void, with no subscription/history requirement. Target O(1) own time/storage excludes callback work and opaque payload storage. Add one visible count assertion, two positive/rejecting compiler probes and three hidden assertions carrying B096 state fixtures plus 13 opaque states crossed with 13 replacements, independent caller-owned object references and 10000 updates. Independent closure passes; double invocation and erased updater types passed the original suite and fail the new semantic/type checks respectively.

objective: Notify independent subscriptions from a stable snapshot on real state changes.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Subscriptions support UI adapters and observable application state.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Distinguish a registration from its callback function identity.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Idempotent unsubscribe, snapshot iteration, Object.is and detached methods transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the first subscription milestone after exact updates.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Deduplication can silently discard a consumer registration and unsubscribe the wrong one.

defects: Repeated registration of the same function was not exercised.
Snapshot add/remove timing and return-value behavior needed explicit bounds.
The subscribe return and detached off signature had no own added rejection probe.
rationale: Keep all three correct modules: wrapper Set, array records and numeric Map each provide independent registrations. Each subscribe creates one registration; its detached off removes only that registration and is idempotent. Snapshot additions wait until the next change; removals do not cancel an already queued call. Ignore listener returns, preserve original values/Object.is NaN and signed zero, and allow subscribe/unsubscribe within listeners while excluding throws/same-store updates/this dependence. Bound live listeners at 256 and state-changing operations at 10000. Target O(n) own time per operation and O(n) registration space, n=live count+1 at operation start, excludes callbacks/payloads. Add visible repeated-function registration, two compiler probes and three cumulative hidden tests for duplicate/off behavior, snapshot mutation, opaque/no-op equality, independent stores and the 256-listener boundary. Independent numeric-ID alternative passes; function deduplication passed originals and now fails.

objective: Undo real changes by restoring original state references and exact notifications.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Undo supports editors and reversible state transitions.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Record past values only when Object.is reports a real change.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Reference ownership, direct history traversal and precise boolean returns transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits undo before the subsequent redo milestone.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Copying restored arrays changes identity and bounded history silently loses earlier state.

defects: Only simple history values were covered.
Exact restored references, no fixed cap and no-op history rules were implicit.
An any-erased undo return satisfied inherited signature checks.
rationale: Retain correct sole undo reference and cumulative subscription/update/opaque-state checks. Record original references on real changes, restore directly and notify once on undo; empty undo returns false without effects. Equal set/update creates no history. Require detached methods, no fixed history cap, at most 10000 state operations/256 live listeners and no redo yet. Target O(n) own time per state operation, amortized in the usual array append/pop model, O(h+n) retained storage with h=past count+1 and n=live listeners+1; get O(1), excludes callbacks/payloads. Add visible array identity, two compiler probes and three cumulative hidden checks: 16 seeds of 96 independent model operations over NaN/zeros/opaque references, mutable/frozen history identity/no-op boundaries and 1000 changes plus 1000 undos with 2000 notifications. Independent timeline alternative passes; cloned restored arrays and erased undo return passed originals and fail respective new checks.

objective: Traverse undo and redo history without losing references or a valid redo branch.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Bidirectional history supports practical editing workflows.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Separate new changes from movement through retained history.
relevanceRationale.transferable: No-op equality, branch invalidation, notifications and exact references transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the full history milestone after undo-only.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Artificial history caps discard valid transitions; no-op changes can incorrectly destroy redo.

defects: Long histories and exact Object.is no-op preservation were not checked.
A shared upper complexity bound had to include the senior timeline splice.
Redo return relationships needed an own rejecting compiler probe.
rationale: Keep all three correct history modules, including the senior timeline implementation. Preserve original values and no-op redo, discard only the redo branch on a real new change, and never record undo/redo as a new change. No cloning/freezing/fixed history cap; retain detached methods/nonthrowing nonreentrant callback domain, 10000 state operations/256 live listeners. Target O(h+n) own time per state operation and O(h+n) space, h=all retained history including redo before operation+1, n=live listeners+1; this includes deleting the senior redo suffix without penalizing valid faster stack operations. Add visible NaN/signed-zero redo, one rejecting probe and three cumulative hidden tests: 16x96 independent model traces, exact object branch/no-op sequences and 1000 changes/1000 undos/1000 redos with 3000 notifications. Indexed alternative passes; a 32-entry cap passed the original suite and fails the declared boundary.

objective: Cache a typed selected value from the minimal subscribable source.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Derived state avoids repeated work and supports external store adapters.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Compute once initially and once per source notification, then read a cache.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Structural source interfaces, opaque cached U and generic inference transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the get-only selection checkpoint before derived subscriptions/disposal.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Recomputing on reads changes reference identity and repeats selector work.

defects: Original examples accepted recomputing the selector on every get.
Minimal source ownership, notified-value use and opaque cached identity were implicit.
An any-erased selected getter could pass inherited state probes.
rationale: Keep the correct sole selection reference. Accept exactly a structural get():T/subscribe((T)=>void):()=>void source, which emits no immediate subscription event and notifies with current original T. Run select once from source.get() at creation and once from each supplied notification value; get returns exact cached U without source reads/recomputation/clone/await. Selectors do not throw, change the source or depend on this; only get is required before derived subscribers/dispose. Target O(1) own time/space per creation, notification/get excluding selector/source work and opaque payloads. Add visible cached array identity, two compiler probes and three cumulative tests for minimal external sources/read/subscription/selector counts, real-store no-op/undo/redo notifications and Promise U, plus 10000 changes yielding 10001 selector calls. Independent cache passes; per-get recomputation and erased selected return passed originals and fail semantic/type checks.
